To clarify:


1. No one except Super-Admin and higher can give points to people through their profiles.
2. There is no way for anyone to give points for shoutbox comments. The workaround is just giving them a point through their profile. That has to be done by a higher admin, see 1.
3. Test-Admins and Admins cannot give out any warning points. Only Admin+ and higher can give out warning points by giving them through a forum post they wrote.


I hope that clears up some of the confusion.
